scripts.setup: npm ci --prefix server && npm ci --prefix client
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build:server
scripts.build:server: npm --prefix server run db:generate && npm --prefix server run build
scripts.lint: npm --prefix server run lint && npm --prefix client run lint
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix client run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --prefix server run test && npm --prefix client run test
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm test
